fact: Decree No. 2017-104/PR of 10 August 2017, published in the Journal Officiel, is made in application of Law No. 2016-006 of 30 March 2016 on freedom of access to public information and documentation, and sets out the public bodies concerned, the officials responsible, the documents that may be communicated, and the procedure for communicating and publishing them online.
